summary: Independent fresh-context read-only review of 32c4577 (admin alerts hidden from sessions without adminPowers: SQL filter on list, count and both mark-reads; admin-role-only socket delivery; SPA feed re-read on profile change; docs), then of the review fixes aba1beb and the CLAUDE.md wording pass 17dacb9.
